# WC20 · Patient 360 · hồ sơ vừa tạo

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · state · Next.js: **built (U3)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#action`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#overview`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#summary`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- A profile created in WC3 opens straight on this tab with empty lists, zero sessions and no plan: the screen of a patient without history.
- Inventory note: Right after "Tạo hồ sơ": a patient with no plan, sessions or invoices (empty variants of the cards, "Cần khai thác tiền sử" alert, "Chờ bác sĩ thiết lập kế hoạch"). The new record is added to the demo data of the browser only.
- Page key `patients` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `careAction=add-prescription` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=edit` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=care` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `careAction=add-service` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `careNav=cashier` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"[data-modal=\"patient\"]"} → {"fill":["#new-name","Nguyễn Thử Nghiệm"]} → {"click":"[data-action=\"create-patient\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"}; it must show "Chờ bác sĩ thiết lập kế hoạch".

Kit components used: Button×13, Card×12, Badge×5, Tabs×1, EmptyState×1; shared pieces: Notice×5. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.
